# Assets · Icons

54 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

These are the glyphs `UWeedDesignSystem_8df554.Icon` and every `icon=` prop render — mount the component wherever the bundle runs; the files are for surfaces without it (a deck).

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for adjustments-horizontal.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Icons

The 54 icons uWeed uses, from [Tabler Icons](https://tabler.io/icons) (version 3.49.0), a free open-source family under the MIT licence. Tabler was chosen in October 2026 because it is built the way the logo is: one even line, round ends, simple geometry.

- In the interface, draw icons with the `Icon` component. It holds the same artwork and inherits `currentColor`.
- These files are for surfaces without the component, such as a slide or a document: 24×24, 2px line, `currentColor`. Shown through `<img>` they draw in black; recolour them in code, not in the file.
- File names are Tabler's own names. `star-filled.svg` and `heart-filled.svg` are Tabler's solid star and heart; every other file is a line icon.
- To add an icon, take it from Tabler under its published name and add the file here and the name to `Icon` together. Never mix in another family. Where the site needs an icon Tabler does not have, flag it: it is then drawn once to Tabler's rules (24px grid, 2px line, round ends) and added like any other.
- The only change made to Tabler's files is the removal of an invisible bounding rectangle and a `class` attribute. The drawings are untouched.

## Replaced names

These icons replaced an earlier stand-in set in October 2026. Twelve changed name:

| Before | Now |
| --- | --- |
| `arrow-up-down` | `arrows-sort` |
| `chevrons-up-down` | `selector` |
| `circle-alert` | `alert-circle` |
| `flask-conical` | `flask` |
| `funnel` | `filter` |
| `globe` | `world` |
| `info` | `info-circle` |
| `menu` | `menu-2` |
| `rotate-ccw` | `arrow-back-up` |
| `sliders-horizontal` | `adjustments-horizontal` |
| `ticket-percent` | `rosette-discount` |
| `triangle-alert` | `alert-triangle` |

`cannabis` and `star-filled` are new. `help-circle` was added on 25 October 2026 for the FAQ link in the header menu, and `heart-filled` on 27 October 2026 for the header favourites icon once something is saved. `user-check` was added the same day for the header account icon when the visitor is logged in, and `news` on 30 October 2026 for the Magazin link in the header menu. On 16 November 2026 the footer redesign added `message-circle` (live chat), `link` (contact page) and four brand marks for the social links: `brand-instagram`, `brand-facebook`, `brand-telegram` and `brand-linkedin`.
